caption: The drawing depicts a single heeled shoe shown from three different angles: side view, top view, and back view. The shoe is a light beige or cream color with subtle shading to indicate texture and form. It features a rounded toe and a strap across the upper front, fastened by a button or buckle. The front and top of the shoe, as seen in the side and top views, are decorated with a floral embroidery pattern in pink, red, green, and brown colors. The heel is curved and moderate in height, and the overall design is detailed with fine black outlines. The shoe has a vintage or historical style. At the bottom right corner of the drawing, the name "LILLIAN CAUSEY" is written in small, light grey text. The background of the image is plain and uncolored.
title: Woman's Slippers
